title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Reach 9.69 Million According to Sensor Tower (Unconfirmed)
description: A recent post on Reddit highlights Sensor Tower data showing 9.69 million pre-orders for GTA 6. Read on for details and context.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Pre-Order Numbers Surface via Sensor Tower Tracking

Anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to break boundaries, with community discussions constantly unearthing new metrics. A recent post on the Reddit community r/GTA6 by user /u/Pistoluislero has drawn significant attention by sharing tracking data from Sensor Tower (sensortower.com/grand-theft-auto-VI/sales-tracker), indicating that **GTA 6 pre-orders have reached 9.69 million**.

It is crucial to note that this information stems from a community submission referencing third-party market tracking. Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have not released official pre-order milestones or sales figures regarding this specific 9.69 million metric. Consequently, this data should be treated as an unconfirmed estimate circulating within the fan community rather than official corporate data.

### Understanding the Data and Community Reaction

The gaming community has closely monitored any indicators of GTA 6's commercial gravity. While Sensor Tower is widely recognized for digital market intelligence, tracking complex pre-order pipelines across multiple platforms for a major AAA title involves estimation models that may differ from internal publisher data. Without official confirmation from Rockstar, the exact scale of early purchases remains speculative.

### Editor's Take

While a 9.69 million pre-order figure aligns with the unprecedented hype surrounding GTA 6, we must approach community-shared third-party data with caution. Until Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive provides official verification through their financial reports, these numbers remain unconfirmed. Stay tuned to official channels for verified updates.
